title: Apple App Store Search Scraper
description: Apple App Store Search Scraper collects structured data from Scrappa's /apple/app-store/search endpoint. Submit multiple inputs in one Actor run and receive one dataset item per result. Submit multiple batch entries in one run.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Batch input entries. Each query is sent as the query value.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search term (q is accepted as an alias)

store.title: Store
store.description: Store vertical: apps, mac, books, audiobooks, movies, tv, music, or podcasts

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Apple storefront country code (default: us)
